newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fresenius Medical shares higher pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius Medical shares higher pre-bourse.

text.p: Shares in Fresenius Medical Care (FMC), German medical group Fresenius AG's dialysis subsidiary, rose strongly on Wednesday morning on an upbeat reaction to Tuesday's analysts' meeting.
Shares were up 7.40 marks, or five percent, at 155.50 marks, while the overall IBIS DAX index of electronic trade was up 34.81 points, or 1.05 percent, at 3,362.94 points.
Neither FMC nor its parent Fresenius AG profited much from positive figures on Tuesday, and dealers said there was an element of catch-up in the positive performance in pre-bourse trade.
Fresenius preference shares also outperformed the market, up seven marks, or 1.94 percent at 367 marks.
"Fresenius and FMC have room for growth, offer innovative products and a good management structure. They will stay on the buy list," a Frankfurt dealer said.
